Qwen3.8-Flash

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian) · Latest lightweight, 1M-token context

TextImage understandingVideo understandingLatest lightweight1M-token context

Qwen3.8-Flash is the latest lightweight model in Alibaba's Qwen3 series on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. It supports text, image and video understanding with a 1000K (1M-token) context window, priced per 1M tokens in CNY.

API pricing (official list price, CNY per 1M tokens)

Input (cache miss)¥0.8

Cache hit¥0.1
Time-based pricing Single price around the clock

Site calculation: estimated monthly cost at default usage

Site calculation, not a vendor quote. Assumptions: 100 calls/day · 2000 input / 800 output tokens per call · 30-day month · 30% cache hit rate. Same formula as the cost calculator.

Effective input price30% × ¥0.1 (cache hit) + 70% × ¥0.8 (standard) = 0.59 CNY/1M tokens
Input cost100 × 30 × (2000 ÷ 1,000,000) × 0.59 = ¥3.54
Output cost100 × 30 × (800 ÷ 1,000,000) × ¥2.7 = ¥6.48
Estimated monthly cost¥10.02

Notes and limitations

· Prices are official published list prices per 1M tokens in the original billing currency (here CNY). Limited-time promotions, resource packs and subscription discounts are not included; the vendor's console prevails.

· "Verified" is the date this page's figures were last checked against the official source linked above. Pricing changes over time — confirm on the source page before making decisions.
